comment: Default lint metadata - defines available rules and their default configurations. FPGA-relevant rules: forbid_nonstandard_arith (detect non-IEEE arithmetic libraries), forbid_positional_portmap (require named port associations)

signal_naming.message: Signal '${name}' should be lowercase with underscores

constant_naming.message: Constant '${name}' should be UPPERCASE with underscores

variable_naming.message: Variable '${name}' should be lowercase with underscores

port_in_naming.message: Input port '${name}' should be lowercase, optionally ending with '_i'

port_out_naming.message: Output port '${name}' should be lowercase, optionally ending with '_o'

port_inout_naming.message: Bidirectional port '${name}' should be lowercase, optionally ending with '_io'

library_naming.message: Library '${name}' should be lowercase with underscores

generic_naming.message: Generic '${name}' should be UPPERCASE with underscores

entity_naming.message: Entity '${name}' should be lowercase with underscores

architecture_naming.binding_message: Architecture '${name}' for entity '${entity}' (suffix '${suffix}') must be one of: ${allowed}
architecture_naming.message: Architecture '${name}' should be one of: rtl, struct, behavioral, tb

package_naming.message: Package '${name}' should be lowercase, optionally ending with '_pkg'

type_naming.message: Type '${name}' should be lowercase with underscores

subtype_naming.message: Subtype '${name}' should be lowercase with underscores

allowed_libraries.message: Library '${library}' is not in allowed list: ${allowed}

max_line_length.message: Line exceeds maximum length of ${max} characters (actual: ${actual})

forbid_tabs.message: Tab character found at column ${column}; use spaces instead

forbid_nonstandard_arith.message: Non-standard arithmetic library '${library}' detected; use ieee.numeric_std instead

forbid_positional_portmap.message: Positional port mapping detected; use named associations (port => signal)

clock_reset_naming.enforce_message: Reset port should be named '${expected}', found '${name}'

same_file_units.entity_message: Entity '${name}' has no architecture in this file
same_file_units.architecture_message: Architecture for entity '${name}' has no entity declaration in this file
same_file_units.package_message: Package '${name}' may need a package body in this file
same_file_units.package_body_message: Package body for '${name}' has no package declaration in this file

forbid_bit_types.message: Use of '${type}' type detected; use std_logic or std_logic_vector instead

forbid_positional_genericmap.message: Positional generic mapping detected; use named associations (generic => value)

forbid_latch_inference.message: Signal '${signal}' may infer a latch in process '${process}' - missing default assignment

forbid_wait_statements.message: Wait statement in process '${process}' - not synthesizable

forbid_unconstrained_ports.message: Port '${port}' in entity '${entity}' is unconstrained - may cause synthesis issues
